THET2/TT_C0087.description: TT_C0087 encodes the Thermus thermophilus HB27 IscS cysteine desulfurase, a pyridoxal-phosphate-dependent enzyme that mobilizes sulfur from L-cysteine. Purified IscS supports sulfur incorporation into tRNA U34 in a reaction with reconstituted MnmA. This biochemical donor capacity does not establish that IscS is the sole native donor or exclude intervening carriers in the cell. The same named donor also enhances the separate TtuA/TtuB-dependent tRNA U54 thiolation reaction in vitro.

supported_by.supporting_text: In the absence of reductant, s2U was readily formed by the cysteine desulfurases using cysteine as the sulfur donor.
The addition of cysteine desulfurases such as IscS (TTC0087) or SufS (TTC1373) enhances the sulfur transfer reaction in vitro.

knowledge_gaps.gap_statement: The native allocation between IscS and SufS and possible additional sulfur carriers is unresolved.
knowledge_gaps.significance: Both purified donors support MnmA activity; biochemical capacity is not evidence that either supplies all native U34 flux.

THET2/TT_C1373.description: TT_C1373 encodes the Thermus thermophilus HB27 SufS cysteine desulfurase. It uses pyridoxal phosphate to mobilize sulfur from L-cysteine, and purified SufS supports C2 thiolation of tRNA wobble uridine by reconstituted MnmA. Its physiological allocation between sulfur pathways and its relative contribution compared with IscS remain unresolved. The same named donor also enhances the separate TtuA/TtuB-dependent tRNA U54 thiolation reaction in vitro.

reference_review.review_notes: I checked that PP_3996 is named tusE and carries IPR007453/TIGR03342 DsrC/TusE support; the sidecar places it between TusBCD and MnmA by E. coli relay analogy and motif conservation, not direct KT2440 biochemistry.
